brief:
Chris Hedges has released "Requiem for Gaza," a graphic novel created with cartoonist Joe Sacco that documents the experiences of 29 Palestinian families, according to The Chris Hedges Report. The work presents firsthand accounts from Gaza during the ongoing conflict.

Hedges discussed the book during an appearance on The Jimmy Dore Show, where he addressed the nature of the military operation in Gaza and the documentation of Palestinian civilian lives captured in the graphic narrative format.
dek: Chris Hedges details his his latest book, “Requiem for Gaza,” a graphic novel created with cartoonist Joe Sacco that documents the experiences of 29 Palestinian families.
title: Hedges and Sacco document Palestinian families' experiences in Gaza graphic novel
